newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND SELECTORS SHOW FAITH IN LOSING SIDE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND SELECTORS SHOW FAITH IN LOSING SIDE.

text.p: England cricket selectors on Tuesday expressed a vote of confidence in the side which lost the third test to Australia, keeping the same players for the fourth test starting on July 24.
In a surprise move, the 12-man squad was named more than two weeks before the start of the next test at Headingley in Leeds.
Spinner Phil Tufnell was the only player added to the team which lost the third test by 268 runs at Old Trafford. The series is now tied at 1-1.
Fast bowlers Devon Malcolm and Mike Smith, who were included in the squad for the third test, were overlooked by selectors.
England squad: Michael Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andy Caddick, Dean Headley, Phil Tufnell.
